title: cmd: laptop to robot drive command
description: Sent about 20 times a second while the laptop wants control. If none arrives for 300 ms the robot stops and holds position. Unknown keys are ignored by the robot.

seq.description: Counter raised on every command; echoed as ack in telemetry (#14).

mode.description: drive: follow v and w. balance: stop and hold here. idle: motors off. None of them starts balancing; only the one-letter command g does.

v.description: Forward speed, m/s, + forward. The robot clamps it to +/-3.2 (its step generator's ceiling; the steppers stall sooner).

w.description: Turn rate, rad/s, + turning left. The robot clamps it to +/-1.5.
